Use case: stylized-concept, identity-preserving game asset.
Generate one complete Soldat Panzer from Resident Evil Village (2021), using the attached original source as the exact identity, armor, machinery and material reference. Preserve the box-shaped metal respirator helmet with its original circular vents and rubber hoses, irregular layered steel chest and shoulder plates, all straps/belts, armored legs and both armored boots. Keep the asymmetrical chest armor and source-specific hardware on their original anatomical sides. There are exactly TWO powered forearm drill assemblies and exactly THREE long spiral drills on EACH forearm: SIX drill bits in total. The reference visibly establishes three distinct drill shafts and tips per arm; do not simplify them to two, add extra bits, turn them into fingers, or swap one arm with another Soldat type.
Required view: physically turn the ENTIRE soldier into a clear three-quarter RIGHT-FACING combat idle, showing its anatomical LEFT flank nearest the viewer. Helmet, chest plates, waist, knees, boots and the axes of both forearms all point toward the RIGHT side of the image. The front of the chest is foreshortened; the pose must not read as a frontal stance with only the head turned. Keep the silhouette legible, with believable overlap of the far arm but enough separation to count all six drills. Both feet are on the same implied ground plane. Preserve exact model identity and rusty steel/rubber/leather colors and proportions, with neutral readable lighting.
A newly drawn physical turn, never a horizontal reflection of the source. One figure and one pose only, no duplicate, inset, action, effects, scene, victim, label or watermark. True transparent alpha background with no floor or cast-shadow plate. Frame the entire subject with at least 8 percent transparent breathing room on every side; every drill tip, helmet hose, shoulder plate and both complete boots must be inside the canvas. Original source tips are close to its sides, so do not copy that tight framing.

Use case: stylized-concept, identity-preserving game asset.
Create ONE full-body transparent character asset of Duvalia in its opened-shell state, exactly the Resident Evil 5 (2009) form in the attached original source. Preserve the same whole opened fan of dark red-purple segmented shell lobes, the exposed central circular tooth-bearing structure, the source's distinct drooping toothed side appendage, the remnant belt and camouflage trousers, and exactly two black boots. Preserve the same asymmetry and attachment topology: the drooping long toothed appendage at image-right in the source stays on the creature's anatomical LEFT side. It must not become a third leg, a new arm, a separate creature or a head on a neck.
Required orientation: turn the ENTIRE opened-shell creature physically into a clear three-quarter RIGHT-FACING combat idle. Its shell/tooth-ring attack front, waist, trouser legs and boots all face toward the RIGHT edge of the image. Anatomical LEFT side is nearest the viewer. Foreshorten the shell opening consistently with the same body rotation so that it is clearly aimed to the right, not a frontal fan perched above right-pointing feet. Keep both boot tips and all original shell lobe endpoints contained and legible; retain the asymmetrical side appendage on its original side through a real 3D turn. Do not mirror the source.
Match the supplied 2009 proportions, shell coloring, segmented surfaces, camouflage and footwear. Do not invent new shell lobes, spikes, limbs or added gore. Neutral readable game-model lighting. Full-body single figure in one pose, generously framed with transparent margin on all four sides. True alpha background; no original black plate, floor, fog, effects, people, inset, other form, text or watermark.
